query:
INSERT INTO access.roles (id, scope, tenant_id, key, name, is_system, created_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
             ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
               scope = EXCLUDED.scope,
               tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id,
               key = EXCLUDED.key,
               name = EXCLUDED.name,
               is_system = EXCLUDED.is_system
